Verified label/distributor channels are preferred when artist upload is absent.

promotionRules.canonicalSong: Requires at least one canonicalMetadata source or an official artist/label source with unambiguous title and artist.
promotionRules.canonicalRelease: Requires an official streaming/store/label source. Community or blog signals alone are insufficient.
promotionRules.liveSet: Official artist/label uploads rank above distributor uploads; community uploads may be retained as discovery-only.
promotionRules.recommendation: May originate from community/editorial/blog sources but must retain provenance and review date.
promotionRules.playback: Use local licensed audio when available; otherwise visible official provider embeds/links. Never rip protected streams.
